exposure: antenatal anemia (hemoglobin value of < 11.0 g/dL within 3 months before delivery)
cohort: 3988 adult women with antenatal anemia (hemoglobin value of < 11.0 g/dL within 3 months before delivery)
finding: Intravenous iron for antenatal anemia was not associated with a significant change in the incidence of PND.
mod_finding: Women who received intravenous iron therapy more commonly had repeat cesarean delivery compared to those who did not.
